rules.sentence: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is the gold standard radiological investigation for diagnosing meningioma.[4]
Asymptomatic and slow-growing meningiomas are usually managed with observation along with routine imaging.[4]
However, for fast-growing tumors, large tumors, or symptomatic patients, surgery remains the best management option.
About 1 to 3% of meningiomas can be transformed into malignant tumors with a 5-year survival rate of 32 to 64%.[2]
